findings.current: A forest of glittering steel covered the city walls and advanced, raising red flowers as it went.
findings.defect: 성내 means inside the city, not the city walls.
findings.rationale: The fighters are advancing through the city; the source does not place them on its walls.
findings.replacement: A forest of glittering steel covered the city and advanced, raising red flowers as it went.
findings.source: 번뜩이는 강철의 숲이 성내를 뒤덮고, 붉은 꽃을 피워 올리며 전진한다.

findings.current: So deep a darkness that even the two giants of the dark-path figures—who had once fought the Hundred Thousand Demonic Disciples at the center of the Heavenly Demon—had faltered.
findings.defect: The draft puts the disciples at the center of the Heavenly Demon; the Heavenly Demon led the force the two giants fought.
findings.rationale: 천마를 중심으로 한 describes the opposing demonic force, not the position of the disciples.
findings.replacement: The darkness was deep enough to shake even the two giants of the dark path, who had once fought the Hundred Thousand Demonic Disciples led by the Heavenly Demon.
findings.source: 천마(天魔)를 중심으로 한 십만마도와도 맞서 싸웠던, 흑도의 두 거인마저 마음이 흔들릴 만큼.

findings.current: They were afraid of Dark Heaven’s power, and the spies they’d planted inside long ago had proposed surrendering to survive.
findings.defect: “They’d planted” makes the two leaders the agents who installed the spies. The source identifies the spies as having been planted within their ranks, without assigning the planting to those leaders.
findings.rationale: 내부에 심어져 있던 is passive; the spies' proposal was directed at the fearful leaders.
findings.replacement: They were afraid of Dark Heaven’s power, and spies planted in their ranks long ago had urged them to submit in order to survive.
findings.source: 그들은 분명 암천의 힘을 두려워하고 있었고, 이미 오래전부터 내부에 심어져 있던 간자들은 굴복을 통한 생존을 제의했었지.

findings.current: No—maybe I was this glad to see him because of the person on his back.
findings.defect: The source explicitly contrasts Great Sir himself with the person he is carrying; “him” drops that identification and contrast.
findings.rationale: 대인이 아니라 names the person Taekyung is reconsidering his relief at seeing.
findings.replacement: No—maybe it wasn't Great Sir himself I was so glad to see, but the person on his back.
findings.source: 아니, 어쩌면 이토록 반가운 것은 대인이 아니라 그의 등에 업혀 있는 한 사람 때문일지도 몰랐다.

findings.current: The Abbot of Shaolin Temple is no ordinary man, so you’d better believe him without arguing.
findings.defect: The draft turns Jeok's pointed appeal to the Abbot's stature into a neutral assertion about him.
findings.rationale: 그 대단한 points to the Abbot's reputation, with a dry edge that fits Jeok's exchange about Hong Dao.
findings.replacement: The great Abbot of Shaolin Temple said it, so you’d better believe him without arguing.
findings.source: 그 대단한 소림사 방장이 하는 말이니 네놈도 군말 없이 믿어라.
